name: spredo
description: Work with your Spredo workspace: review Telegram outreach campaigns, read and answer your inbox, set up campaigns and follow-up sequences, and size B2B audiences.

interface.longDescription: Connect Spredo to ChatGPT to manage your entire B2B sales workflow on Telegram without leaving your chat. Spredo is an AI-powered sales platform with 300,000+ Web3 and 60,000+ iGaming business contacts, 30+ targeting filters, automated Telegram outreach, and a built-in CRM. Find and validate decision-makers, create campaigns, generate personalized messages, launch outreach, manage conversations and follow-ups, and analyze campaign performance — all through natural language. Spredo MCP works with your existing workspace permissions and is equipped with platform documentation and outreach best practices. Ideal for business development, partnerships, lead generation, and sales teams operating in Web3 and iGaming.
defaultPrompt: Find C-level contacts at Web3 wallets, exclude non-custodial wallets, and validate the selection before outreach.
Create a campaign for the selected leads, generate personalized Telegram messages, set up follow-ups, and prepare it for launch.
Review last week's campaign replies, find interested leads, prioritize chats that need a response, and suggest next steps.
